subject: Pioneer Health SIG activation playbook — post-call recap & clarifying asks
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Pioneer Health SIG activation playbook — post-call recap & clarifying asks

Hi Amanda —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a short list of clarifying asks so we can spin up the SIG/CAIQ path quickly: 

Topline recap:
- Primary use: patient intake summarization + embedding search for provider notes (PHI in scope; HIPAA applies).
- Expected QPS: small initially (~5 rps) with ramp to steady-state 25 rps over 6 months.
- Residency requirement: US (East) preferred; SaaS deployment acceptable if BAA in place.

Immediate asks / clarifying questions:
1) SOC 2 status: can you confirm whether Pioneer Health has a current SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC 2 in progress? If in progress, estimated report date?
2) Regulatory scope: you mentioned HIPAA and GDPR applicability for a subset of users — can you confirm which datasets/users are subject to GDPR?
3) Questionnaire preference: do you want us to complete SIG (preferred by most of our health customers), CAIQ, or a custom questionnaire? We can supply a prefills template to speed the process.
4) Evidence & point-of-contact: who on your side will own evidence collection (certs, diagrams, subprocessor list)? Best email for that contact?
5) Timeline: target date for prefill completion and any internal procurement windows we should align with.

Attachments: attached is our prefills template to make completion faster — "redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx" [Attachment: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx (Excel)].

Suggested next step: 30-minute technical deep-dive with your security engineering contact to walk through data flows (we can do Tue/Nov 25 10:00–10:30 PT).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-sig-prefill-template.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Amanda Li <amanda.li@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@pioneerhealth.com>, security@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 17:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pioneer Health SIG activation playbook — post-call recap & clarifying asks

Thanks Diego — good notes and appreciate the template. Quick answers from our side: 

1) SOC 2: We do not have a finalized Type II right now. SOC 2 Type II audit is in progress; draft testing started Oct 2025 and our auditor (ClearCheck) expects the final report around 2026-01-15. We can share interim evidence (policy docs, controls matrix) sooner.

2) Regulatory scope: HIPAA applies to all production patient data. GDPR applies only to EEA-based patients (we have a small subset of international patients in our pilot). For GDPR-impacted data we need data residency and DSAR handling documented.

3) Questionnaire preference: SIG works best for us — majority of our security team is familiar with it. If you can prefill the SIG template that’ll be ideal.

4) Evidence owners: Tom Harris (cc'd) will lead evidence collection; primary inbox is security@pioneerhealth.com. For procurement/legal routing reach out to contracts@pioneerhealth.com (not cc'd).

5) Timeline: target is to have a completed prefill back to you by Dec 15, 2025. Tech deep-dive on Tue/Nov 25 at 10:00 PT works for Tom and me.

Attachment: I uploaded a short priority doc that lists the items we typically expect from vendors — "pioneer-sig-priority.pdf" [Attachment: pioneer-sig-priority.pdf (PDF)].

I'll loop in our engineering security lead during the deep-dive.

Best,
Amanda Li
Director, Security & Compliance
Pioneer Health
amanda.li@pioneerhealth.com
[Attachment: pioneer-sig-priority.pdf (PDF)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda.li@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@pioneerhealth.com>, security@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sun, 23 Nov 2025 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pioneer Health SIG activation playbook — post-call recap & clarifying asks

Amanda — perfect, thanks for the fast turnaround and the timeline. A few follow-ups so we can prefill accurately: 

- SOC2 interim evidence: could you share the controls matrix and any current test results (redacted is fine) to help map to SIG control IDs? If you're comfortable, we can accept a subset as "in-progress" and flag for audit follow-up after the final report.
- Encryption and KMS: is encryption at rest customer‑managed via KMS, or do you use a vendor-managed key store? Which KMS provider (AWS KMS / Google KMS / Azure Key Vault)?
- Audit log retention: expected retention period for logs (e.g., 90/180/365 days)?
- Subprocessors: do you maintain a public subprocessor list or should we expect to request that per-evidence ask?

We’ll prefill the SIG template and call out any gaps tied to the SOC 2 timeline. For the deep-dive (Tue 11/25 10:00 PT) Ben will join to cover ingestion and data residency routing. Can you confirm Tom + one security engineer will be on the call and share a Zoom link?

Thanks —
Diego
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.com
